mechanism.name: FOURHOUR_JPY_FACTOR_RESIDUAL_WITH_CROSS_PEER_COHERENCE
mechanism.definition: At UTC hour t: require authentic consecutive H1 closes at t-1..t-5 for AUDJPY, EURJPY, GBPJPY and CHFJPY. Compute 4h returns of 3 JPY references; cross-sectional median minus AUDJPY 4h return is the predeclared residual. If abs(residual)>=0.0015 and peer returns max-min<=0.008, direction is sign(residual); one hour delayed original M5 open entry/exit. Prospectively estimated residual movement scale 0.65 must exceed 1.25 times baseline declared AUDJPY spread+slippage+fee in EUR. Thresholds predeclared before ANY original JPY residual return.
mechanism.distinct_from_closed: Previous V4-JPY-FACTORED-DISCORDANCE-20261101 requires 3h all-peers same sign AND opposite 1h AUDJPY, was executed without preserved economic result and is permanently closed. This is 4h return-relative residual against median reference peers, no unanimity, no last-hour counter-move rule, symmetric long/short residual. Not a retuning, inversion or relaunch of closed identity. Source/time geometry supports comparison without any observed previous economic values.
